question: What did the LORD swear about His name among the people of Judah in Egypt?
options: They would carry His name to all nations
They would build Him a temple in Egypt
His name would be written on their doors
No one from Judah living in Egypt would ever again invoke His name
explanation: The LORD said, "I swear by my great name… that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name."
